tasks.short: Review dish sales and seasonal supplier lists, plan the menu with the team, test new recipes, cost them and put new dishes and prices in the till.

steps.what: Chef reviews dish sales, expected covers and suppliers' seasonal lists
Chef collaborates with sous-chefs and the manager to plan recipes and menus
Chef tests and tastes new dishes in the kitchen
Chef writes the recipe cards and costs each dish in a spreadsheet
Chef re-keys new dishes and prices into the till

tasks.design: A menu view in the recipe app ({OTHER}) shows sales and margin per dish from the till ({OPS_SYSTEM}), the expected covers from the sales forecast and suppliers' seasonal prices side by side. Tested recipes are entered once; the app costs them from current supplier prices and sends new dishes and prices to the till. Planning with the team and testing recipes stay in the kitchen.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sales, prices and recipe costs sat in separate spreadsheets and the till was keyed by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Recipe apps link supplier prices, recipe costs and till sales.
tasks.still_hard: Seasonal produce varies in quality; the chef has to taste, not just read prices.
tasks.human_edge: Building a spring menu around the first good asparagus.

reach.learn: Whether shared margin views change which dishes the team proposes.

evidence.claim: Apicbase rolls ingredient prices up to portion cost, applies connected suppliers' price changes and adds labour for a prime cost.
Tenzo forecasts sales with machine learning; managers adjust the forecast in an app.
Guests must get information on the 14 EU allergens, so new recipes need allergen data.

assumptions: Boundary: from sales review to the till menu; printing the menu card is outside.
Input contract: sales from the till; prices from connected suppliers; covers from the sales forecast; fallback is spreadsheets.
Planning and testing do not change.
Sous-chefs' and the manager's time is outside the chef's savings.
research_questions: Do new dishes hit their target margin more often?

already_counted.description: Chef reads the menu view before planning.
Chef checks the cost roll-up of each new dish.

incremental.description: Chef keeps recipes and supplier links current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most of this task is planning with the team and testing dishes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The chef keeps menu ideas, tasting and team planning; spreadsheets and re-keying the till shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A chef who plans menus from sales and seasons in one view.
